title: Git、静态分析与性能剖析闭环
objectives: 在 CMake/CTest 中实际执行 warnings-as-errors 静态分析门禁、可复现 Git bisect fixture 与确定性热点计数。
victoryConditions: Reference 在干净目录通过严格编译告警、真实 git bisect run、profile/bisect 工件校验与行为测试。

starterFiles.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(engineering_diagnostics LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
add_executable(engineering-diagnostics main.cpp)
target_compile_options(engineering-diagnostics PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow -Werror)
enable_testing()
add_executable(engineering-diagnostics-tests tests.cpp)
target_compile_options(engineering-diagnostics-tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(engineering-diagnostics-tests PRIVATE PROFILE_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PROFILE.md" BISECT_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/BISECT.md")
add_test(NAME diagnostics-evidence COMMAND engineering-diagnostics-tests)
if(NOT CPP_LEARN_GIT)
message(FATAL_ERROR "trusted Git runtime is required")
endif()
add_test(NAME reproducible-git-bisect COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DGIT=${CPP_LEARN_GIT} -DFIXTURE_ROOT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bisect-fixture -DCHECK_SCRIPT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/check_regression.cmake -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/git_bisect.cmake)
starterFiles.git_bisect.cmake:
if(NOT DEFINED GIT OR NOT DEFINED FIXTURE_ROOT OR NOT DEFINED CHECK_SCRIPT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "missing trusted bisect fixture inputs")
endif()
file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${FIXTURE_ROOT}")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}")
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" init WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" RESULT_VARIABLE result OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET)
if(NOT result EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "git init failed")
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" config user.email learner@example.invalid WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}")
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" config user.name "C++ Learn Fixture" WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}")
file(WRITE "${FIXTURE_ROOT}/state.txt" "linear-baseline\n")
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" add state.txt WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}")
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" commit -m linear-baseline WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" OUTPUT_QUIET)
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" rev-parse HEAD WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" OUTPUT_VARIABLE good OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
file(WRITE "${FIXTURE_ROOT}/state.txt" "quadratic-regression\n")
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" commit -am quadratic-regression WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" OUTPUT_QUIET)
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" rev-parse HEAD WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" OUTPUT_VARIABLE bad OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" bisect start "${bad}" "${good}" WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" RESULT_VARIABLE start_result OUTPUT_QUIET)
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" bisect run "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -DSTATE=${FIXTURE_ROOT}/state.txt -P "${CHECK_SCRIPT}" WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" RESULT_VARIABLE bisect_result OUTPUT_VARIABLE bisect_output ERROR_VARIABLE bisect_error)
execute_process(COMMAND "${GIT}" bisect reset WORKING_DIRECTORY "${FIXTURE_ROOT}" OUTPUT_QUIET)
if(NOT start_result EQUAL 0 OR NOT bisect_result EQUAL 0 OR NOT bisect_output MATCHES "first bad commit")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "git bisect did not reproduce the first bad commit: ${bisect_error}")
endif()
starterFiles.check_regression.cmake:
file(READ "${STATE}" state)
if(state MATCHES "quadratic-regression")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "performance regression reproduced")
endif()

hints.title: 先找不变量
hints.content: 先写出输入、状态所有者和必须保持的结果，再定位对应标准库或系统接口。

hints.title: 区分机制与策略
hints.content: 接口只提供同步或表达机制；边界、失效、错误与资源上限仍由程序定义。

hints.title: 查看完整答案
hints.content: 在 CMake 为 app/tests 同时开启 Wall、Wextra、Wpedantic、Wconversion、Wshadow 与 Werror；main 读取 n 个整数，空输入输出 none，否则从第二项开始线性扫描并令 comparisons 等于实际比较次数。PROFILE.md 记录 warnings-as-errors、four/nine 两组计数和 linear-scan 热点；BISECT.md 记录 git bisect run 定位 quadratic-regression。CTest 还必须创建两提交的隔离 Git fixture 并真正执行 bisect run。

reflections.prompt: 如何用 Git bisect、回归测试、clang-tidy 与 profiler 形成一条可复现的性能故障调查链？

teacherRubric.prompt: 应准确解释 engineering-diagnostics、profiling-evidence 的不变量、故障边界和验证证据。
